releases.body:
- Did some clean up to the code, comments and efficiency (i think...)
- Added clearer notification support for the process of Remote Autopilot.
- Added alternative keys options in the settings, If options are on, the Numpad will be replaced with the main keyboard layout of the same options.

Enjoy! :)
releases.bodyZh:
- 对代码、注释和效率进行了一些清理（我认为...）
- 为远程自动驾驶过程添加了更清晰的提示支持。
- 在设置中添加了替代按键选项，如果选项开启，数字键盘将被替换为相同选项的主键盘布局。

享受吧！:)

releases.body:
Added notification system so that you know which location is currently selected.
Made it so the ship will not collide with the sun (Do NOT be inside during transit now...)

Enjoy!
releases.bodyZh:
添加了通知系统，以便您知道当前选择的是哪个位置。
使其不会与太阳发生碰撞（现在...不要在过渡期间进入里面...）

享受吧！
